'''2008 Utah State Championship''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG state championship played on Friday 20 June 2008 at Press Box Sports Cards, 10261 S 1300 E, Sandy, Utah, organized by [[Scott Church]].<ref name="sf-19270-305519">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=305519#p305519 Utah States & Tatooine Regionals June 20 & 21st], CategoryOneGames.com (Scott Church), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (4 June 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125175520/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t19270-start60.html Internet Archive]</ref> [[Aaron Nelson]] won and received the bye into Day 2 of the [[2008 World Championship|World Championship]]; eight players took part.<ref name="sf-19270-308685">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=308685#p308685 Utah States & Tatooine Regionals June 20 & 21st], CategoryOneGames.com (Scott Church), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (21 June 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125175129/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t19270-start140.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sf-22883-332133">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=332133#p332133 List of People who have Worlds Day Two Auto Bids 2008], simone89 (Cedric Simon), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125194535/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t22883.html Internet Archive]</ref> The [[2008 Tatooine Regionals]] were played at the same store the next day.<ref name="sf-19270-305519" />

== Organization ==

In April 2008 Church asked the forum whether out-of-state players would come to a two-event Utah weekend; he noted that most local players were Mormon and would not play on Sunday, and that most public places in Utah were closed on Sundays.<ref name="sf-19270-294929">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=294929#p294929 Utah States & Tatooine Regionals June 20 & 21st], CategoryOneGames.com (Scott Church), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (22 April 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125174919/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t19270.html Internet Archive]</ref> The events were therefore held on Friday and Saturday. Church's February announcement planned a three-judge (tier 3) system for the state championship.<ref name="sf-19270-270348">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=270348#p270348 Utah States & Tatooine Regionals June 20 & 21st], CategoryOneGames.com (Scott Church), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (24 February 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125174919/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t19270.html Internet Archive]</ref> The entry fee for each event was $10, and six rounds were played, with the top two meeting in a final on Friday.<ref name="sf-19270-305519" /> The Players Committee's western calendar of 17 June 2008 added that the store did not allow play for money, so the entry fee was to be paid outside the store.<ref name="sf-21362-307955">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=307955#p307955 Road to Worlds - Western US - All West States Events/Plans], Advocate (Scott Lingrell), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (17 June 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125191252/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21362.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Press Box Sports Cards, 10261 S 1300 E, Sandy, Utah<ref name="sf-19270-305519" />
* '''Dates:''' 20 June 2008<ref name="sf-19270-305519" />
* '''Time:''' 3:00 pm<ref name="sf-19270-305519" />
* '''Format:''' constructed, six rounds and a final between the top two<ref name="sf-19270-305519" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $10<ref name="sf-19270-305519" />
* '''Organizer:''' [[Scott Church]]<ref name="sf-19270-305519" />
* '''Winner:''' [[Aaron Nelson]]<ref name="sf-19270-308685" /><ref name="sf-19270-315735">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=315735#p315735 Utah States & Tatooine Regionals June 20 & 21st], simone89 (Cedric Simon), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (16 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125175210/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t19270-start160.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Results ==

James Lewis posted the pairings and results round by round during the event.<ref name="sf-19270-308622">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=308622#p308622 Utah States & Tatooine Regionals June 20 & 21st], Captain_Twinkie (James Lewis), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (21 June 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125175129/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t19270-start140.html Internet Archive]</ref> Church posted the final standings early the next morning. Kevin Shannon declined the final, so Aaron Nelson received the bye. Light Side went 14–10 overall, and the group from California arrived about two hours late, so play ended around 11 pm.<ref name="sf-19270-308685" /> Shannon corrected that it was Nelson, not he, who played Watch Your Step; Shannon played an almost all-Japanese EBO deck.<ref name="sf-19270-308693">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=308693#p308693 Utah States & Tatooine Regionals June 20 & 21st], Kevbozzz (Kevin Shannon), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (21 June 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125175129/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t19270-start140.html Internet Archive]</ref> Lewis corrected that he had played SYCFA Mains, not Fear.<ref name="sf-19270-308707">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=308707#p308707 Utah States & Tatooine Regionals June 20 & 21st], Captain_Twinkie (James Lewis), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (21 June 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125175129/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t19270-start140.html Internet Archive]</ref>
